General Summary:

About Qualcomm Robotics 

Qualcomm Advanced Robotics Team is building the AI first stack and platform for the next generation general purpose robots - from AMRs and cobots to emerging humanoids by pairing heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU) with a full Robotics SDK and developer tooling for manipulation, perception, navigation, and fleet workflows. We are leveraging our success in automated driving product portfolio, advanced AI end to end development and tools, and safety architecture to accelerate the growth in this emerging market. 

About the Role 

We are building a new robotics lab and are looking for hands-on roboticists who are excited about putting state‑of‑the‑art SoCs, Software and AI into real, physical robots. This role is focused on taking advanced AI models, algorithms, and systems—and making them work reliably on-device, on real robotic platforms operating in the real world. 

You will be part of a team translating cutting‑edge advances in AI, compute, and connectivity into complete physical AI systems. This includes deploying modern perception, VLA, and reasoning models onto robots, integrating them with sensors and actuators, and validating that they perform as expected outside of simulation. The work spans development, integration, testing, and demo readiness, with a strong emphasis on seeing how AI behaves when embedded in real robotic systems. 

This is a highly applied role at the intersection of mechanical systems, software, robotics, and AI. You’ll work hands‑on in the lab building and iterating on robot applications that showcase how Qualcomm’s technologies—Dragonwing, AI Engine, compute, Wi‑Fi, and 5G—enable intelligent, connected robots. Expect to spend time deploying models to hardware, debugging system‑level issues, building sample and reference applications, and preparing robots for internal and external demonstrations. 

If you are passionate about closing the gap between state‑of‑the‑art AI research and real‑world robotic capability—and want to work directly with robots as they perceive, plan, move, and act—this role is for you. 

What you’ll do 

Build end‑to‑end robotics applications that integrate perception, planning, control, and actuation on-device 

Deploy AI and robotics models developed by research teams onto physical robots and evaluate real‑world performance 

Translate Qualcomm’s AI, compute, and connectivity portfolio (Dragonwing, AI Engine, Wi‑Fi, 5G) into working robotics solutions 

Perform robot integration and system bring‑up, including sensors, actuators, compute platforms, and networking 

Develop and maintain robot applications for internal testing, external demos, and sample/reference solutions 

Design and execute robot testing, validation, and benchmarking in lab environments 

Prepare robots for demo readiness, ensuring reliability, repeatability, and polished behavior 

Debug complex cross‑disciplinary issues spanning mechanical systems, electronic systems, embedded software, perception pipelines, and control 

Collaborate with AI, systems, hardware, and platform teams to close the loop between development and deployment 

Actively work in the robotics lab—configuring robots, running experiments, and iterating quickly with hardware 

Why Qualcomm 

You will help stand up a brand‑new advanced robotics lab and shape how we build and test robots from day one 

You will work on real robots, not just simulations or papers 

You’ll see your work used in demos, reference platforms, and sample applications 

You’ll be at the center of turning advanced AI and compute into physical AI systems 

You’ll work across disciplines, touching everything from sensors and motion to AI inference and connectivity 

Minimum Qualifications:

•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related field. 

Experience working with physical robots in lab or field environments 

Strong foundation across robotics domains, including:  

Perception (vision, sensors, AI models) 

Planning and/or decision‑making 

Control and actuation 

Systems integration 

Electronics 

Metrology (e.g. sensor calibration procedures, high-performance measurement sensors) 

Ability to take models, algorithms, or prototypes and deploy them onto real robots 

Practical experience running robot testing, validation, and demos 

Comfort developing full robotic applications, not just isolated components 

Experience integrating hardware, software, and AI into cohesive systems 

Familiarity with robotics software stacks (e.g., ROS/ROS2 or similar frameworks) 

Strong debugging skills and a bias toward hands‑on problem solving 

Willingness and enthusiasm to work onsite in a robotics lab ​

Background in mechanical, electrical, software, or systems engineering (or a blend) 

Experience with on‑device AI deployment and optimization 

Familiarity with networking, connectivity, or distributed robotics systems 

Experience building reference designs, sample applications, or demo platforms 

Prior work supporting customer demos or public demonstrations 

Exposure to mobile robots, manipulators, drones, or autonomous systems 

Why Join Us? 

Shape the core platform that powers intelligent, safe, and scalable robotic operations. 

Work with some of the most advanced robotic AI models on the planet. 

Influence the optimization and deployment pipeline for next‑generation robotic intelligence. 

Competitive compensation, deep technical growth, and the opportunity to shape the future of on‑device AI.
